item.title: Hong Kong: Legal AI Systems Strengthen Compliance and Practice
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University showcased next-generation legal AI systems that enhance cross-border compliance, streamline legal workflows and strengthen the city’s role as a regional legal services hub.

item.title: Vietnam: Accelerating UAV Innovation and Development
item.description: Vietnam’s UAV industry is rapidly developing, with pilot projects, growing manufacturing capacity and supportive policies positioning the country as a regional hub for innovation, logistics and emergency applications.

item.title: Singapore: Upskilling for a Sustainable, Tech-Savvy Workforce
item.description: Singapore’s Green Skills Committee report outlines practical upskilling pathways to equip workers with the digital, technical and sustainability capabilities needed for a low-carbon, tech-driven economy.

item.title: Malaysia: Modernising Borders with Automated Gates and Biometrics
item.description: Malaysia will deploy automated gates and biometric systems nationwide by 2028 to improve immigration screening efficiency, security resilience and manpower optimisation.

item.title: Singapore: Strengthening Digital and Community Resilience
item.description: Singapore launched Exercise SG Ready 2026 to strengthen digital resilience and Total Defence, preparing citizens, businesses and communities to respond effectively to evolving cyber threats, scams and disruptions.

item.title: Australia: Hypersensitive Chip Offers Non-Invasive Glioblastoma Insights
item.description: UQ researchers developed a hypersensitive diagnostic chip that monitors glioblastoma treatment response through blood samples, reducing reliance on invasive brain procedures.

item.title: Philippines: Digital Innovation in Infrastructure, Energy, Tourism
item.description: The Philippine government is leveraging digital innovation and strategic partnerships to modernise infrastructure, energy and tourism, improve services and drive inclusive economic growth nationwide.

item.title: Hong Kong: CityUHK Unveils Interpretable AI Asset Pricing Model
item.description: CityUHK researchers developed an interpretable machine learning model that improves asset pricing and portfolio construction by analysing complex financial data.

item.title: Vietnam: E-commerce, Digital Innovation Driving Inclusive Growth
item.description: Vietnam’s e-commerce sector is driving the nation’s digital transformation, combining innovation, regulatory reforms and technology adoption to modernise commerce and strengthen competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: National Space Agency to Drive Innovation and Industry Growth
item.description: The National Space Agency aims to strengthen space capabilities, grow industry, expand partnerships and develop regulations supporting innovation, safety and sustainability.
